findings.problem: D1-F0079 resolves source-deictic «esto / las cosas» into municipal communication about actions concerning the pool, but its own evidence set does not bind the topic antecedent.
findings.recommended_resolution: Bind the smallest sufficient preceding pool/Contraloría discussion context or narrow the canonical proposition.

source_evidence.exact_text:
Regidor suplente Rolnald Robles: Aquí estábamos discerniendo acerca de si se
36   podía publicar esto que estamos hablando en la página de la Municipalidad, porque
37   a veces hay que aclararle a las personas las cosas que se están haciendo de
38   buena fe y con buena voluntad.

findings.source_grounded_reason: The local source only says they were considering publishing «esto que estamos hablando» and clarifying «las cosas» being done in good faith. The canonical pool-process topic requires bound surrounding discussion.

findings.problem: D1-F0828 resolves «tomemos un acuerdo hoy mismo» into an agreement specifically about the bianual Games change, but the fact does not bind the proposal content that establishes the agreement's subject.
findings.recommended_resolution: Bind the proposal-content antecedent before the same-day agreement sentence.
